messages:
maria: FYI escalation from customer (Acme Corp) — Dedicated deployment intermittently returning 403 on SSO-authenticated requests. They say same token succeeds when hitting model pod directly, fails via VPC LB -> Istio -> dedicated-gateway chain. Repro steps attached.

maria: Repro steps:
1) Complete SSO, get opaque cookie/token
2) Edge LB forwards as Authorization: Bearer <opaque-token> to gateway
3) Gateway should convert/validate and call backend, but response is 403 with missing_scope/missing_claim errors

maria: Header dump from failing request:
```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: dedicated.acme.internal
Authorization: Bearer opaque123fragmented
Cookie: _sso=abcd
X-Forwarded-For: 10.1.2.3
X-Request-Id: req-112233
```

maria: Gateway log snippet:
```
2024-11-22T12:01:23Z ext_authz: request denied, missing claim 'scope'
2024-11-22T12:01:23Z envoy: header_normalization: Authorization -> authorization (lowercased)
```

sam: @maria can you paste the raw headers as received by envoy (pre-ext_authz)? guessing some proxies are lowercasing or duplicating Authorization.

tess: :thinking: Customer said problematic path is GCP NLB (TCP) -> Istio ingressgateway -> dedicated-gateway. NLB TCP mode can fragment/truncate headers.

kevin: Do we have a reproducer cluster or is this only on their env? Also which ext_authz config are we enforcing (scopes vs scp)?

maria: Customer env yes. Quick curl repro they ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer opaque123fragmented" https://vpc-edge.acme/v1/generate
```
They get 403 {"error":"missing_scope"}. Hitting backend pod directly returns 200.

infra-bot: ingress-check v1.3 scanned: findings -> authorization header duplication: true; ext_authz policy: expects claim 'scope' string.

sam: Two possibilities: 1) Token claim name mismatch (scp vs scope) 2) Header normalization/duplication causing ext_authz to read the wrong header.

jamie: Ask customer to supply a redacted base64 payload of the token so we can inspect claims (no private keys). Also ask which SSO proxy minted the JWT.

maria: They provided an obfuscated token payload (trimmed): eyJhbGciOiJ... (redacted). Decoded shows claims: {"sub":"u-123","scp":["read"]} — note claim name is 'scp' array. Our ext_authz expects 'scope' as space-delimited string.

tess: That explains missing_scope. Who in the chain converts the opaque cookie to JWT? It might be our private SSO adapter or customer's SSO broker. If broker uses 'scp' we're incompatible.

sam: Short-term workaround: add a small Envoy Lua filter in ingress that maps scp -> scope before ext_authz evaluation. Low risk and reversible.

kevin: Alternative quick fix: instruct customer to send a custom forwarded header (x-redwood-auth: Bearer <jwt>) that our gateway will prioritize, or set preserve_external_authorization_header: true in gateway config so we don't regenerate/normalize headers. Note: NLB may strip non-standard headers with underscores; use hyphenated header.

maria: Customer tried adding a custom header but NLB in front strips some headers by default. They can add x-redwood-auth which passed through in earlier tests.

jamie: Steps for us to reproduce locally:
- Stand up GCP NLB in TCP mode (or simulate fragmentation) -> Istio ingressgateway -> dedicated-gateway deployment
- Send requests with Authorization header and a duplicate lowercased authorization header to see which ext_authz picks up
- Deploy EnvoyFilter with Lua to map scp->scope and verify ext_authz grants

tess: I'll spin a test cluster and simulate NLB behavior. @kevin can you check current EnvoyFilters in dedicated clusters for header-normalization rules?

kevin: On it. Also opening an internal issue and tagging eng-infra for a config patch. Marking this P2 due to customer impact but working workaround available.

maria: Customer asked for ETA for a fix and prefers config patch. Can we propose pushing Lua mapping to Dedicated config as a short patch?

jamie: Yes, low-risk ConfigMap change. Target: roll to staging tonight, prod tomorrow if tests pass. I'll prepare PR.

kevin: Created internal tracking: GH-54321 (will attach logs, token sample, and reproducer steps). Linking to eng-infra channel for visibility.

infra-bot: escalation created: support-23456 -> eng-infra; severity P2.

maria: Customer OK with config-level workaround. I'll coordinate staging tests and notify once patched. Thanks team :thumbsup:

support-ops: Please add postmortem checklist if rollout changes Auth pipeline.

maria: Closing thread here, will update when eng-infra confirms deploy.
